reason: Provides a see tool for analyzing image files through OCR with positions, ASCII layout rendering, and optional semantic description from an external vision model, returning text suitable for text-only models.

summaries.zh: 通过 OCR 坐标识别、ASCII 布局图和可选的视觉模型语义描述，将图片分析结果以纯文本形式输出。
summaries.en: Analyzes image files with positional OCR, ASCII layout rendering, and optional vision-model descriptions, returning the results as plain text.

capabilities: Reads image files from the session filesystem
Performs offline OCR using macOS Vision
Generates ASCII layout representations with Python and PIL
Sends image-derived data to a configured external vision-model gateway
Reads configured API credentials through the host credentials service or a YAML file
Runs local Swift and Python subprocesses with timeouts and cancellation
